ad_library.summary: Evergrid Energy is running 2 active Dussehra-offer ads on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), started on 16 and 17 October 2026. Both ads send the click into a Facebook lead form, so the spend never reaches evergridenergy.in. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every rupee of ad spend lands inside Facebook's form. You own no pixel, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not submit, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on.

findings: Both live ads dump the click into a Facebook lead form - not your website. No pixel ownership, no retargeting pool, no page to test.

Your own site has a real quote form (name, phone, installation type, monthly bill, location) and a projects page - Kukatpally 6 kW residential, Shamshabad 120 kW commercial, Nacharam 20 kW commercial - that none of the paid traffic ever sees.
The contact page shows contact@evergridenergy.in while the form's own mailto points at hello@evergridenergy.in - enquiries can land in an inbox nobody is watching.
Two ads, both the same offer, both new (16-17 Oct). There is no second angle and no retargeting creative behind them yet.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Send both ads to a dedicated landing page with the Dussehra offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel installed - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not submit - usually 10-20x the size of the people who fill a form.
Put your project photos to work
Kukatpally, Shamshabad and Nacharam installs are real proof. They belong on the landing page next to the offer, not on a page the ad never sends anyone to.
Point the contact form at the same inbox the site advertises, and add a second address so an enquiry can never sit unread.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
